note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: Display Panel
parts.description: The flat 16:9 screen itself: an LCD panel with a backlight that produces the picture. It sits behind a glossy front surface.

parts.name: Thin Bezel
parts.description: The slim frame around the screen, with a slightly deeper bottom edge that carries the logo and power LED.

parts.name: Back Cover
parts.description: The plastic rear housing that encloses the electronics and power board. It has vent slits along the top to let heat out.

parts.name: VESA Mount
parts.description: A standard 100 x 100 mm mounting plate. It lets the screen clip onto the stand or onto a wall or arm mount instead.

parts.name: Height-Adjustable Stand
parts.description: The upright column of the stand. The screen slides up and down it so you can set a comfortable viewing height.

parts.name: Cable Management
parts.description: An opening through the stand column that gathers the power and video cables so they run neatly down the back.

parts.name: Stand Base
parts.description: The weighted V-shaped feet that keep the monitor stable on the desk while taking up little space.

parts.name: I/O Ports
parts.description: Downward-facing video and USB ports under the back cover, where the PC, power and accessories plug in.
